technical_and_design_decisions: Extend Kafka source module in Spring XD to accept starting offset parameters (e.g., smallest/largest/specific offset) upon stream deployment.
Implement static/pre-allocated partition assignment strategy in Spring XD Kafka source and Message Bus to prevent dynamic consumer rebalancing during deployment and container failure/redeploy.
Develop a custom 'reactor-stream' processor module utilizing Project Reactor to support time-windowed streaming operations and aggregate calculations (min, avg, etc.).
Add microbatching support to inbound endpoints by introducing a batchInterval parameter to collect messages into micro-batches prior to downstream processing.
Conduct Spark Streaming POC targeting Spring XD architecture for distributed stream processing and integration.
assumptions: A single senior developer will perform all analysis, design, implementation, infrastructure setup, testing, and documentation tasks.
Spring XD code base and build environment are already available and setup on Java 17+ environment.
Rackspace infrastructure credentials and cloud resources are accessible for performance benching.
Wiki platforms (e.g., GitHub Wiki or Confluence) are accessible for user-facing documentation updates.

activities.activity_description: Write user documentation and wiki pages detailing configuration guidelines for new sources, sinks, reactor-stream processor, microbatching, and Kafka offset controls.
Implement deployment-time starting offset configuration for Kafka source modules, offset tracking, state persistence across crashes, and re-read behavior on redeployment.
Implement logic in Spring XD Kafka source module to pre-allocate partitions across source instances during stream deployment to eliminate dynamic rebalancing.

activities.activity_name: Message Bus Partition Pre-allocation across Nodes (U4)
activities.activity_description: Enhance Spring XD Message Bus to support fixed partition pre-allocation between container nodes during stream deployment, ensuring resilience against rebalancing on crashes.
Investigate Spark Streaming integration with Spring XD, build a Proof of Concept (POC), and document design recommendations for XD architecture integration.
Develop the reactor-stream processor module supporting time-window operations (e.g., min, avg), expression evaluations, and integration options with Spark/Reactor pipelines.
Implement microbatching mechanism for stream ingestion modules using batchInterval parameters to optimize throughput performance.
Provision and configure Rackspace performance testing environment, establish Kafka baseline benchmarks, and execute performance test suites for Spring XD stream workloads.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across Kafka offset handling, partition allocations, microbatching, and reactor-stream processor features.
